concept.title: NoteForge Overview
concept.shortdesc: NoteForge is a cross-platform notes app that syncs your content across all your devices.

conbody.p: NoteForge stores your notes in the cloud and makes them available on any device where you are signed in. Changes you make on one device appear on all others within seconds.
The Free plan includes unlimited notes and basic organisation features. The Pro plan adds real-time collaboration, advanced tagging, and priority support.
